description: This is a 3D model preview of a contemporary or mid-century modern style chandelier. It features a central vertical rod extending from a ceiling mount, from which multiple white, slender arms branch out. Each arm terminates in a spherical white shade or light bulb, creating a geometric and somewhat atomic-inspired design. The overall aesthetic is minimalist and clean, with a uniform white color for all components, including the structure and the spherical lights. The design gives the impression of a stylish and sculptural lighting fixture.
